content:
kevin: DAST pipeline failed on staging for /api/v1/uploads — scanner shows an XSS payload but the service returned 401. logs show KMS decrypt denied for scanner test creds.
ajay: i think this is from the RBAC cleanup yesterday. scanner service account lost kms:Decrypt on the test key. saw similar in canary earlier.
security-bot: ALERT: 3 failed kms:Decrypt attempts for principal service-scanner@staging within the last 5m (rule: kms-decrypt-failures).
maria: if scanner can't decrypt the ephemeral creds it will hit auth errors and produce noisy false positives. we should avoid granting broad access. options:
  1) create a dedicated key for scanner in staging and restrict its key policy to the scanner service account + infra ops.
  2) rotate to ephemeral test creds stored in a vault the scanner can request (no direct KMS access).
linda: i'm leaning dedicated key for now (faster) but with strict audit and short TTL. also we need an RBAC exception record for the recent prune, link to ticket for compliance.
kevin: can someone run a quick query to confirm decrypt failures across staging clusters? e.g.:
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.cluster_name="staging" AND protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND severity>=ERROR' --limit 50 --format=json
```
ajay: running now, will paste results in ~10m. if it's the RBAC prune, we should see the principal: service-scanner@staging-sa.
maria: also, we should export KMS audit logs to our SIEM sink so we have a long-term trail. quick terraform example (sketch):
```hcl
resource "google_logging_project_sink" "kms_sink" {
  name        = "kms-audit-sink-staging"
  destination = "bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-datalake/datasets/kms_audit"
  filter      = "logName:projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access AND resource.type=\"kms_key\""
}
```
sre-oncall: note — if we add a new key for the scanner, ensure it's only in staging. do NOT modify prod key policies without an SRE runbook entry. rekeying plan if we ever rotate is required by infra policy.
kevin: agreed. proposed action items:
  - ajay: confirm log evidence + open RBAC PR to re-add kms:Decrypt for scanner service account on key-scanner-staging.
  - maria: create logging sink and dashboard for kms decrypt/deny rates, add alert on spike.
  - linda: file compliance exception + attach evidence, include rollback plan.
  - kevin: re-run DAST after ajay's change and validate whether the finding disappears.
kevin: timeline? can we do EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ajay: EOD looks doable, i'll update the PR and paste logs here when done.
maria: sink will take a bit to wire into SIEM rules, probably 48h for first alerts. i'll at least create the sink and dataset today.
linda: filing the exception now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-3021 — i'll attach ajay's logs + planned key policy change.
security-bot: REMINDER: please document the key policy change and add audit steps to the security-runbook channel after remediation.
kevin: thanks team :thumbsup: i'll wait for ajay's log paste and then re-run the scanner once RBAC PR is merged.
